facts.fact: Galaxy Backbone's second data centre (Kano, built from 17 Huawei prefabricated containers) achieved Uptime Institute Tier IV certification for both design and constructed facility; Galaxy Backbone says it is the first in Nigeria with both. Date is the page date (the page says 'recently').

Galaxy Backbone, the federal government's ICT company, operates data centres in Abuja and Kano and says the Kano facility strengthens its cloud, disaster recovery and business continuity services to public and private sector organisations. Date is the page date.
